scope: Targeted static backend review of task/story/project/member/role/status/reference/milestone/epic models; CRUD/serializer hooks, advisory locking and field-history OCC; selected bulk order/milestone/Kanban writers and post-commit SQL; parent closure signals; context/attachments/custom schema, history, durable notifications/email/live events/webhooks, JWT/application authentication/project permission filters and notification read-marker boundary; search/export/container/configuration; selected integration assertion bodies and pinned django-pglocks dependency source. Relevant model/API/router inventories searched for dependency/lease/heartbeat/claim/attempt/idempotency alternatives. Frontend reviewed separately. Not every-line, all import/extension/migration/token/provider/file-serving/security/scaling/browser/runtime or concurrency certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Normal task validator/permission/pre-save/save/history/notifications; related-project and member-assignee checks; bulk creation uses transactional save loop with callbacks. Story creation has explicit transaction. No reviewed create/comment idempotency-key contract; stable row IDs and project-local regenerating reference sequences.
lifecycle_review.select: Permission-scoped filtered task/story/search snapshots and planning orders, not reservations; blockers are bool/note and no dependency DAG/readiness/cycle authority in reviewed models and operation inventory.
lifecycle_review.claim: Mutable assignee/multiple story assigned users; ordinary modify permissions. Explicit atomic normal edit plus model/id session advisory lock and history-field version validation do not enforce unowned/eligible/current-attempt acquisition. Task/story object preloaded before lock; serializer full save permits stale snapshot risk, not runtime reproduced.
lifecycle_review.progress: Normal versioned edits, timestamps, comments, attachments with digest, wiki/custom fields, snapshots and persistent notifications. Task bulk order/milestone SQL deferred until on_commit with event scheduled first and exhausted DatabaseError retries suppressed; bulk story Kanban status/swimlane bypass OCC/version increment and recalculation/history may run later.
lifecycle_review.review: Configurable statuses can represent review; no qualified reviewer/artifact-version acceptance or result/test gate in reviewed task/story normal/bulk transitions. Attachment SHA1/deprecation is content metadata, not a review decision.
lifecycle_review.complete: Task status drives finished_date; story with non-null status and children closes iff all tasks closed, without children uses story status; deleting last task changes rule. Milestone aggregates stories/unparented tasks/issues with nonempty constituent. Signals and bulk async paths differ; no accepted child execution join.
lifecycle_review.cancel: Normal delete uses explicit transaction/advisory lock and history pre-delete; record delete/status edit/reassignment has no agent process stop, attempt cancellation, child fanout or external side-effect rollback.
lifecycle_review.recover: Postgres/history/notifications survive client loss and shared host access; no worker lease/heartbeat/resume/fence. Email pending record deleted after caught recipient errors; live on_commit publication lacks SQL outbox; webhook task no automatic retry/explicit send timeout, manual resend and ten retained logs. Notification list user-scoped but per-ID read marker ignores false permission return and lookup not user-scoped; source-level finding, not exercised.

external_sources.method: Read public release metadata and source archive in memory, verify archive hash matches metadata, inspect full contextmanager source. No package installed or executed. Session acquire/release at context entry/exit supports decorator lifetime inference.
